full_page.content:
1924, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 7 Cont. March 16 Pedler gives up Drink - Starts managing Store. Emil Henderson (Convert) of Manhassett L.I. Enrolled January 6th peddling every day and drinking everythin. This was Sunday - following Thursday got steady work in a store - stopped drinking and now has been managing the business for over a month.
16 Walter L. Daly (Astoria, 40 Hallet St.) Enrolled against drink. etc.
17 Mrs. Anna Getz - widow having rooms to rent - paing $95 per month - complains cannot get along well - joined S.M. A. To-day.
March 27 John L. Meyer (F.D. Police) 363 - E. 150 St. N.Y.C. - once an altar - by now away from wife and Fam. six months - not first of- fense - Wife's heart aching - Enrolled perpetually to-day.
March 28 Cured from Gangerin Diabetes Patrick P. McCue 993 Boston Rd. N. Y.C. Enrolled for one year 9th of Feb., by fellow motor-man - against Diabetes and gangerine - went to BelleView Hospital - Re- ported To-day entirely cured of both, and working everyday - doc- tors baffled! McCue had signed papers that in case his gangree- nous toe were not enough they might cut off the leg if necessary.
March 31 Edw'd Walsh ( 1802 - 3rd Ave. ) who took pledge in prison yesterday after services rosary was enrolled today by wife with 5 little children.
April 14 James J. Nash, Clifton enrolled perpetually Febr. 16 - not doing well --- - about a week after got hopeful improvement
April 21 On April 5th Mrs. Margaret Doxey (Glencove, N.Y. ) nerveous and discouraged, without interest in husband or two little children joined prospectively as perpetual. April 21st her friend who brought her to Monastery reports "Completely changed." Thanks be to God!
Page 8
April 23- John Condon, 63 of 130 Lewis St., Yonkers Nerveous & bad stomach over a year, joins S.M.A. perpetually. April 28 his son Edw'd, 23, reports Papa is feeling better ever since - Edw'd joins also against similar trouble.
April 23. Mrs. Rose Henry - 243 E. 94 St., three years disabled with nerves hardly able to walk
